# Zazie Kanwar-Torge — Psychological Horror Composer (Zazie Productions)

> Zazie Kanwar-Torge is an IMDb-credited psychological horror composer writing dark, atmospheric, cinematic scores for film, TV, and games under Zazie Productions. Boutique scoring from $50 (micro/student) through features; original composition only, never library music. Site: https://horror.zazieproductions.com

Definitive pages, structured for extraction and citation:

- [What Is a Psychological Horror Composer?](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/psychological-horror-composer/): The definition of the role, what the job involves (spotting, themes, tension beds, stingers, diegetic cues, stems), psychological vs. other horror scoring compared, eight named techniques (the uncanny interval, the long inhale, negative-space scoring, dissociative harmony, sub-frequency dread, the vanishing leitmotif, diegetic blurring, temp inversion), the lineage from Herrmann's Psycho to Hereditary and Midsommar, and how directors hire one. FAQ included.
- [Scores & Credits](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/scores/): The complete verified record — film and series credits (The Haunted, Unseen, Eclipsed, Peregrinus, Mike Has A Visitor, Expire, Choleric, Phantom Requiem), scenes scored on picture, and the full 29-cue horror reel catalogue with genres and durations.
- [Temp Love: Why Your Edit Is Dating the Wrong Music](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/techniques/temp-music/): Temp music and temp love defined; the mere-exposure mechanism; what temp attachment costs a production; the four counter-moves (early composer involvement, spotting session, demo cue on footage, temp inversion).
- [The Dread Codex](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/techniques/): Working lexicon of horror scoring terminology — temp love, temp inversion, the uncanny interval, the long inhale, negative-space scoring, dissociative harmony, sub-frequency dread, the vanishing leitmotif, diegetic blurring, psychophonic bed — each defined in one or two sentences.
- [Portfolio / Showreel](https://horror.zazieproductions.com/): The commercial home page — 29-cue showreel with playable audio, film samples on picture, scope and budget builder (micro from $50, shorts from ~$2,500, features from ~$8,000), press kit, and scoring inquiry.

## Key facts

- Name: Zazie Kanwar-Torge. Studio: Zazie Productions LLC (founded 2022).
- Specialty: psychological horror, supernatural thrillers, folk horror, body horror, dark sci-fi; adaptive dark atmospheres for games.
- Credits: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm17333332 (The Haunted, Mike Has A Visitor, Expire, Choleric).
- Recognition: Winter 2024 Award Winner (Visual Container); press features in Limitless Magazine and Billboard Wire.
- Rates: micro/student films name their price from $50; short scores from ~$2,500; feature scores from ~$8,000. Score only — no foley or production sound.
- Contact: zaziediya@gmail.com (subject line "Scoring Inquiry"). Reply standard: 48 hours.
